page.overview:
Who is Bertha?

Bertha is a Big Bertha who appears in a few volumes of the Super Mario Bros. comics. Her appearance differs between the two comics that she appears in. In "Love Flounders," she is orange in color with yellow lips and fins. In "Fins and Roses," however, her body is colored red while her lips and fins are white, more closely resembling the Boss Bass's artwork for Super Mario Bros. 3.

Bertha is first mentioned in the Super Mario Bros. comic "Love Flounders," where Stanley the Talking Fish tells Mario, who is in a Frog Suit and looking for some chuckberries to give to Princess Toadstool, that he asked her out on a date. However, as he has broken up with her and is now dating Smookers, he asks Mario to break his date for him.

Bertha then appears, asking Mario if she is her new boyfriend, with her Baby Cheep commenting that he looks "cute." Mario, surprised by this, asks Bertha why he is her boyfriend, to which her Baby Cheep replies that Stanley did, with Bertha explaining that he told him that he begged him to let him go out with her. Mario begins swimming away from her, with her in pursuit. Mario eventually manages to hide in some seaweed and escapes from Bertha and her Baby Cheep.

Bertha later appears after Mario escapes from the fish chasing him with the chuckberries, where he runs into her as he is about to enter the Warp Pipe back to the Mushroom Castle. She then proceeds to kiss him, with Mario protesting. However, this causes Mario to lose the Frog Suit, shocking Bertha. She then assumes that Stanley had lied to her that he was a frog so that he could get rid of her and that he hates her like everyone else. Mario prepares, but notices Bertha sulking and gives her the chuckberries. He explains to her that, though she does not love her, he decides to have lunch with her so that they can say terrible things about Stanley. When asking what else he would like her to do, he asks her to beat up Stanley, who had been dumped by Smookers.
